developmentBacklogAdded.name: Effective freelance value floor
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Excellent keyword/task matches can dominate discovery even when fixed-price or hourly compensation is economically unusable.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Calculate a conservative effective hourly range from stated workload, unit price and expected application overhead; auto-demote offers below a configurable minimum before ranking.

developmentBacklogAdded.name: Cross-board canonical vacancy cluster
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: The same vacancy can appear on government portals, Kariera, LinkedIn and aggregators and inflate source hit counts.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Cluster title+company+location matches across boards, retain each access audit but count one canonical vacancy for candidate/mix analytics and prefer employer/government primary evidence.
